id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying resend domains sync on account level 400

review.posthog_relevance: Resend connector error handling and retry behavior
review.reason: Adds a specific non-retryable classification and user-facing message for a 400 Client Error from the Resend Domains API, while retaining retry behavior for unrelated 400 errors. P1.F1.H1. P1.F2.H1.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of the Resend connector and its configuration; no evidence of actual production incidents or adoption is provided. The score is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness improvement and its associated test, not on unverified operational outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds a new error mapping and its rationale. P1.F2.H1 adds tests. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to the get_non_retryable_errors dictionary, mapping a specific 400 error URL for the Domains API to a user-facing message. P1.F1.H1.
observations.code_quote: "400 Client Error: Bad Request for url: https://api.resend.com/domains": (
observations.posthog_connection: Resend is an external data warehouse connector. This change distinguishes a specific account-level permission error for the Domains API from other 400 errors, preventing unnecessary retries and providing a clearer error message to users. This could prevent a retry loop or help users diagnose account permission issues. P1.F1.H1.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameterized test to verify that the Domains API 400 error is classified as non-retryable, while an unrelated 400 error remains retryable. P1.F2.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: This test validates the behavior established in P1.F1.H1, ensuring the connector correctly distinguishes between retryable and non-retryable errors. P1.F2.H1.
